mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 6 months signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 6 months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) rises above 225, it signals accelerating inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 225, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and residential sales (RSAFS) both rise above their 6-month moving averages, it signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 6-month moving averages, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the regime of high unemployment (UNRATE > 8.5%) and rising labor force participation (PAYEMS > 130000), it signals a recovery phase that leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 8.5 and PAYEMS > 130000, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) over the past 6 months signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST has risen over the past 6 months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90, it signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 90, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the real interest rate (FEDFUNDS - CPIAUCSL) falls below 0.05, it signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS - CPIAUCSL < 0.05, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In the regime of sustained low industrial production (INDPRO < 90 for 6 consecutive months), it signals a deepening manufacturing slowdown that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 90 for 6 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.
